comment: Teacher accurately connects empathy, vicarious experience, social commentary, authorial technique, and text evidence to a novel-study unit.
Lesson moves from quick write and student sharing to big idea, essential question, examples/images, vocabulary, station routines, rubric, and reading schedule.
Teacher uses student responses, quick write sharing, recall prompts, screen/task checks, and rubric discussion, though some understanding is inferred from participation.
Teacher asks interpretive why/how questions about empathy, social commentary, author technique, metaphor, narrator choice, and evidence-based participation.
Strong lesson overall, with minor opportunities to add clearer sensitivity supports for personal sharing/Holocaust content and a more explicit check for quieter students.
